import tmp.sheaf.xif.paper.S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual

noncomputable section
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
set_option linter.unusedVariables false
set_option linter.checkUnivs false

open LeanFormal.IUT
open LeanFormal.IUT.Theorem311Source
open LeanFormal.IUT.Theorem311Source.OriginalInput
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1968QVDeterminedQPilotActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1960QPilotAnchorActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1927GlobalFrobenioidLogShellActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1487OQPilotScalarEqualityActual
open LeanFormal.IUT.IUTIV.Estimates

namespace ProbeS1979

#check @S1487Strip
#check @paperBadBasePlace
#check @paperQPilotDivisor
#check @paperQVOrder_abs_log
#check @reducedQPilotTimesMu
#check @reducedQPilotAnchor
#check @SourceHaarActualValueMonoid
#check @sourceHaarActualDegree
#check @Multiplicative.toAdd
#check @Multiplicative.ofAdd
#check (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)
#check @PaperV
#check @paperQVBad0
#check @S1280Bad_subsingleton
#check @IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg_single
#check @IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg
#check (S1280ReductionClause)

/-- probe: the Mon of the anchor at a place is the nonpositive real monoid -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) :
    (reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v = SourceHaarActualValueMonoid := rfl

/-- probe: element of the anchor's monoid -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) (x : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) :
    (reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v := x

/-- probe: 5 is a prime place -/
def paperBadPrime : PaperV :=
  ⟨5, mem_primeStrip_iff.mpr ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, Nat.prime_five⟩⟩

/-- probe: badPlaces is subsingleton -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) : Subsingleton (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces :=
  S1280Bad_subsingleton D.l

/-- probe: pos of q -/
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    0 < paperQV D b := by
  have h1 : paperQV D b = (S1280ReductionClause D.l).qParameter b := rfl
  rw [h1, S1527_qParameter_eq]
  exact pow_pos (by norm_num) _

end ProbeS1979
